title: Real Retail Sales
units: Real sales: millions of 2017 dollars, seasonally adjusted; price: index, 2017 = 100
source: Census Bureau (Monthly Retail Trade); Bureau of Labor Statistics (CPI); Econvitals calculations.
note: Each kind of store is deflated by the CPI prices of what it sells, and the lines are combined with a Törnqvist index on sales shares. Method: https://econvitals.org/methods/#real-retail-sales
